'''Sil Onda'tek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] henchman for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Kaeline Ungasan]] wished to become a new force in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] criminal activities. Fortunately for him, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] willing to help him during his stay in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Seeing [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as his greatest obstacle, Ungasan wished to obtain a list of security agents working for Jabba. Sil Onda'tek had such a list, so Ungasan tasked the spacer with finding Onda'tek and killing him. Fortunately for him, the spacer succeeded and gave him the [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] containing the list of agents.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Possible depiction of Sil Onda'tek]]

Sil Onda'tek is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who perform a series of quests for Ungasan in Mos Espa must hunt down and kill Sil Onda'tek outside the [[City/Legends|city]].

Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the species and appearance of Onda'tek changes each time a player performs this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the canonical species of Onda'tek. However, the quest dialogue given by Ungasan indicates that Sil Onda'tek is a male.
